text: Get two different people to say the word "umbrella" before the next vote. You may not say it first.
Move a cushion from one room to another before the next vote without anyone seeing you do it.
Steer a conversation onto the subject of dinosaurs and keep it there for at least a minute.
Sit in a different seat at the next gathering and stay there until the vote is over.
Make someone laugh out loud during the next conversation, before any votes are cast.
Use the phrase "as luck would have it" twice in conversation before the next vote.
Get someone to ask you what time it is.
Get three different people to tell you their favourite biscuit before the next vote.
Pay the same person three compliments before the next vote without anyone noticing a pattern.
Get someone to hum or sing a few notes of any song.
Start a conversation about the best holiday you have ever had and get at least two others to join in.
Get someone to hand you an object without asking them for it directly.
Agree warmly with the next three opinions you hear, whatever they are.
Get two people to swap seats with each other before the next vote.
Get someone to say the word "pineapple" during the next conversation.
Ask three different people which superpower they would choose, and remember all three answers.
Offer to help someone with something before the next vote, without being asked, and get them to accept.
Get someone to show you a photo on their phone.
Fold a small paper shape and leave it where someone will find it before the next vote. Do not get caught placing it.
Get someone to use the word "brilliant" to describe something.
Tell a short story that includes a llama, a lighthouse and a lost sock, and get someone to ask a question about it.
Get someone to suggest taking a group photo.
Rearrange three objects on a table or shelf before the next vote without anyone noticing you did it.
Get two different people to tell you about the first concert or show they ever went to.
Get someone to stand up and stretch with you.
Mention the weather in three separate conversations without anyone pointing it out.
Get someone to explain, step by step, how they make a cup of tea.
Keep a pen, coin or similar small object in your hand for the whole conversation without anyone asking about it.
Get someone to change the subject to food without mentioning food yourself first.
Speak only in questions for one full minute during the next conversation without anyone noticing.
Get someone to give you a high five.
Get someone to repeat what they just said by pretending you did not quite hear it.
Get two people to debate, playfully, whether a hot dog counts as a sandwich.
Get a colleague to mention a spreadsheet in a conversation that has nothing to do with work.
Use the phrase "let's circle back" before the next vote and get someone to reply to it.
Get someone to tell you what their very first job was.
During the next conversation, get someone to draw something for you, such as a quick map or diagram.
Get someone to tell you about a meeting they wish they had skipped.
On the call, get someone to unmute and say the word "marmalade".
Get someone on the call to hold an object up to their camera.
Change your video background or camera angle twice before the next vote without anyone commenting.
Get two people to name the cocktail they would order if money were no object.
Steer a conversation onto mortgages, pensions or tax and keep it going for a full minute.
Get someone to recommend an 18-rated film before you name one yourself.
Get the whole group to clap or cheer at the same moment, for any reason, before the next vote.
Teach someone a simple hand game or trick and get them to try it.
